title: NHANES CVD incremental validation reproducibility archive
description: Version 1.1.0 of the analytical code, locked configurations and protocols, frozen model objects, aggregate results, audit gates, and figure source data for repeated cross-sectional and temporal validation of renal, metabolic, and inflammatory markers for prevalent self-reported cardiovascular disease in NHANES. This reviewer-revision archive adds the temporal correction-history table, clarifies conditional survey-bootstrap inference and multiplicity, corrects the Supplementary Table S11 exponentiated-coefficient label, and updates Figure 3 plotting code without changing the locked model fits. Code and model objects are MIT licensed; documentation and aggregate outputs are CC BY 4.0 licensed. No individual-level NHANES data or prediction files are included.
